summary: Glacier View lookout (L-4 cab) stood on the ridge west of Mount Rainier from about 1934 until its removal in 1960; the summit lies in the Glacier View Wilderness.

notes_for_editor: Built about 1934 and removed 1960 agree across firetower, nwhiker, Seattle Times and firelookout.com. Road status conflicts (Seattle Times passable vs WillhiteWeb washouts) and neither page was dated in the cache. Elevation differs by source (5,450 ft nwhiker top of Glacier View; 5,464 ft firelookout.com; 5,507 ft nwhiker Glacier View Point); the brief's 1665.4 m matches 5,464 ft. The 1942-43 activation rests on one hobbyist site and the Seattle Filter Center is not explained by any fetched source. No source describes remains on site. firetower.org photo captions credit the National Archives Pacific Northwest Region; no new photos added.
